sanctification.example: መቀደስ እግዚአብሔር በእኛ ውስጥ የሚሠራው ሥራ ነው።
sanctification.note: God's work of making believers holy over time; never self-improvement or self-optimisation.

calling.note: God's call on a life; not career branding or 'purpose' coaching.

surrender.note: Entrusting oneself and one's desires to God's will (Gethsemane); not resignation, defeat or passivity.

abidingInChrist.note: John 15: remaining joined to Christ in trust and obedience, as a branch to the vine.

worship.note: Honouring God for who He is; praise is one expression of worship.

confession.note: Telling God the truth about sin (1 John 1:9); distinct from a confession of faith.

forgiveness.note: God's forgiveness of sin, and forgiving others; forgiving never requires returning to danger.

prayer.note: Speaking with God; never a meditation technique or positive thinking.
